lines.en: My melon head bobs with each step.
I trudge along the dirt path.
Vines swing from my legs.
My steps thud like knocking on a melon.
I step and pause, very steady.
The seeds rattle inside me.
Sunlight lies on my rind.
I make a way around the garden.
Green leaves brush my shoulder.
I walk where the light is.
There is a crack in my rind.
I lift a foot, half a beat late.

lines.zh: 瓜藤在我腿边绊了一下。
lines.en: A melon vine snags my leg.
The path ends at an open patch.
I stand and blink once.
I say nothing. I only watch.
An insect lands on my rind.
I let the sun bake my rind.
The grass is flattened under me.
It is cool inside me.
The wind cannot push me.
I roll my eyes slowly.
This spot is good for standing guard.

lines.zh: 一只乌鸦落在我的瓜顶。
lines.en: A crow lands on top of my melon head.
My stem has dried a little.
I lift a hand.
There is nobody here.
I keep this pose.
I look at you from under my rind.
You want to knock on me too?

lines.zh: 我瓜皮上的裂缝朝着你。
lines.en: The crack in my rind points your way.
Are you here to plant something?
I watch you through the slit in my rind.
This melon of mine is harder than it looks.
If you swing, I will swing back.
The hollows of my eyes are dark.
There is no snow on you.
I will not melt.
You are standing in my shadow.
I have no ill intent.
My rind has cracked.
That blow landed dully.
One of my vines has snapped.
A few seeds fell out.
It does not hurt much, but it annoys me.
You knocked rather hard.
I raise a hand to guard my head.
I will not melt.
I slowly right myself.
Knock again and I will strike back.
Melon? I react to melon.
Give me that melon slice.
I smell a familiar sweetness.
We are all made of melon.
I walk over slowly.
Do not take it away. Put it down.
I will keep this one.
I hold it and look for a while.
I know the smell of my own kind.
I will not eat it. I will only keep it.
My rind hits with a knock.
You are not as heavy as I am.
I step back and steady myself.
Another mark on my rind.
Your hit lands with a dull sound on my rind.
A vine snaps back off my body.
You are not hurt?
My body is listing slightly.
I shifted my balance.
Run into me again and I will not yield.
I only stand with melons.
I keep this plot.
I loosen the soil.
The vines should climb the frame.

lines.zh: 你也是被谁摆出来的吧。
lines.en: Someone set you out too, did they not?
We stand side by side.
The sun warms us both the same.
Grow slowly. No rush.
This garden has a keeper now.
We will see in autumn.
I stoop and pick it up.
I tuck it into my hollow rind.
This one is a little small.
I lift it and look.
Not a melon. I do not understand it.
I will keep it for later.
My hands are muddy.
I set it down neatly.
I gather what fell.
I am keeping this piece.
Your hand moved.
I have seen it clearly.
I turn a bit at a time.
You are in my patch.
My rind begins to glow.
I raise my arm.
Leave that soil alone.
My turn now.
I step toward you.
I have aimed.
The seeds turn inside me.
I've got the range; I'm striking.
The soil cracks under my feet.
Back up a little.
My eyes do not leave you.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿我盯到哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you go, I follow with my eyes.
My steps are slow, but they do not stop.
You are beside the melon frame.
I raise my hand and aim.
The seeds are spinning.
My palm is aimed at your chest.
I press half a step closer.
A little closer still.
You can outrun me. Yes, I am slow.
But I have another way.
I plant myself and steady my rind.
Light gathers on top of my melon.
This is the moment.
I shove with both hands.
The seeds fire out.
That one hit your shoulder.
I raise my hand for another.
My push sends you stepping back.
A bit of my rind has split.
I raise my hand and my rind creaks.
I pull my hand back and steady myself.
You actually dodged.
I swat once more.
Seeds shoot out of my palm.
That one should be enough.
I shake the dirt off my hand.
The seeds are still flying.
Someone set me out here.
Morning dew still clings to my rind.
Something rises in the field.
Morning light lights up my rind.
Two pumpkins, one of me.

lines.zh: 我本是地球里的瓜傀儡。
lines.en: I was a melon golem from Earth.
Vines have wound around my legs.
A few seeds drop to the ground.
The sun is just right.
I stand in the middle of the garden.
The wind carries melon scent.
I slowly raise my melon head.
Is anyone watching here?
I will watch over this plot.
Fire on my rind makes me feverish.
I fell, and my rind dented.
In the water my seeds float loose.
A corner of my rind blew off.
Something is stuck in my melon.
This light climbs my vines.
There are not enough nutrients in the soil.

lines.zh: 雷打在瓜顶，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck my crown and I jolted.
There is no soil here to stand on.
